idea-plugin.name: Aspire AppHost Services
idea-plugin.description:
Brings Aspire AppHosts to JetBrains editors outside Rider as services, including support for TypeScript AppHosts.
  • Detects aspire.config.json at the repository root
  • Start, stop and restart the AppHost, or attach to one already started from a terminal.
  • Live state, health and endpoints per resource.
  • Console logs per resource, plus a combined log on the AppHost node.
  • Start, stop, restart and run custom commands for each resource.
Requires the Aspire CLI. Tested with IntelliJ IDEA, WebStorm and GoLand. View the source on GitHub.

This is an unofficial community plugin. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Microsoft or JetBrains, and is separate from JetBrains' Aspire plugin for Rider. Aspire is a trademark of its respective owner.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
First release.
  • Detects the AppHost declared in aspire.config.json and shows it in the Services tool window.
  • Start, stop and restart the AppHost and its resources; attach to an AppHost started from a terminal.
  • Per-resource and combined console logs, resource state, health, endpoints and dashboard links.
See all changes on Github
